text: The rate limit is 100 requests per minute per IP address.
Authentication tokens never expire once issued.
A 429 status code is returned when the rate limit is exceeded.
The API supports the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant flow.
The authenticate endpoint requires a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Refreshing a token requires a POST request to /api/v1/refresh with a refresh_token.
Passwords must be at least 12 characters long.
Getting the user profile returns a 404 status code if the user is not found.
The login page shows 'Incorrect email or password' when authentication fails with a 401 response.
The logout endpoint accepts a DELETE request to /api/v1/logout.
The session-expiry banner appears when the access token has less than 5 minutes remaining.
The session-expiry banner appears when fewer than 10 minutes remain on the access token.
The profile page displays a 'Member since' label showing the account creation month and year.
The API supports single sign-on (SSO) via SAML.
A failed token refresh redirects the user to the login page with a message that their session has expired.
Users can enable biometric login (Face ID / Touch ID) from the profile page.
The profile page shows a 'Contact support' link when the profile request returns a 404.
The API's authentication mechanism uses industry-standard security practices.
The 'Sign in' button is disabled after a 429 response from the authenticate endpoint.
A successful login redirects the user to the profile page.
